1: // js/enemies.js — W4: 6 inimigos com FSM idle/alert/chase/attack/pain/death
2: import C from './constants.js';
3: import { moveAxis } from './move.js';
4: import { hasLineOfSight } from './map.js';
5: 
6: const { floor, max, min, hypot } = Math;
7: 
8: // WHY: taxa de ataque por tipo (default 1.0s — não está no C.ENEMY)
9: const ATTACK_RATES = { projectile: 1.2, hitscan: 1.0, melee: 0.8, double: 1.4, arc: 1.1, rocket: 1.3 };
10: 
11: // WHY: direção unitária inimigo -> player
12: const dirTo = (from, to) => {
13:   const dx = to.x - from.x;
14:   const dz = to.z - from.z;
15:   const len = hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
16:   return { x: dx / len, z: dz / len };
17: };
18: 
19: class Enemy {
20:   constructor(kind, x, z, doors = []) {
21:     this.kind = kind;
22:     this.stats = C.ENEMY[kind];
23:     this.pos = { x, z }; // centro do tile (como o player)
24:     this.yaw = 0;
25:     this.hp = this.stats.hp;
26:     this.state = 'idle'; // FSM: idle -> chase <-> attack | -> pain -> chase | -> death
27:     this.timer = 0;
28:     this.attackCooldown = 0;
29:     this.painTimer = 0;
30:     this.dead = false;
31:     this.doors = doors;
32:     this.sightRange = 12;
33:     this.attackRange = this.stats.type === 'melee' ? 1.5 : 8;
34:     // WHY: animação — fase aleatória dessincroniza o bob entre inimigos
35:     this.animT = Math.random() * 100;
36:     this.deathT = 0; // tempo desde a morte (main.js usa p/ animação de queda)
37:     this.attackAnim = 0; // lunge de ataque (main.js decai e translada o mesh)
38:   }
39: 
40:   get alive() { return !this.dead; }
41: 
42:   // WHY: FSM — transição explícita com timer zerado (lição 5: comente cada transição)
43:   setState(s) { this.state = s; this.timer = 0; }
44: 
45:   damage(amount) {
46:     if (this.dead) return;
47:     this.hp -= amount;
48:     if (this.hp <= 0) {
49:       this.hp = 0;
50:       this.dead = true;
51:       this.state = 'death';
52:       return;
53:     }
54:     this.painTimer = 0.2;
55:     this.setState('pain');
56:   }
57: 
58:   // WHY: LOS até o player — DDA do map bloqueia parede/porta fechada/lava (W4)
59:   canSee(grid, player) {
60:     const dist = hypot(player.pos.x - this.pos.x, player.pos.z - this.pos.z);
61:     if (dist > this.sightRange) return false;
62:     return hasLineOfSight(grid, this.pos.x, this.pos.z, player.pos.x, player.pos.z, this.doors);
63:   }
64: 
65:   attackRate() { return ATTACK_RATES[this.stats.type] ?? 1.0; }
66: 
67:   // WHY: ataque por tipo (projectile/hitscan/melee/double/arc/rocket)
68:   fireAt(player, grid) {
69:     const s = this.stats;
70:     switch (s.type) {
71:       case 'melee':
72:         return { type: 'melee', damage: s.dmg, from: { ...this.pos }, target: { ...player.pos } };
73:       case 'hitscan':
74:         // WHY: hitscan só acerta se há LOS no momento do disparo
75:         return { type: 'hitscan', damage: this.canSee(grid, player) ? s.dmg : 0, from: { ...this.pos } };
76:       case 'double': {
77:         const d = dirTo(this.pos, player.pos);
78:         return { type: 'double', damage: s.dmg, shots: 2, from: { ...this.pos }, dir: d };
79:       }
80:       case 'projectile':
81:       case 'rocket': {
82:         const d = dirTo(this.pos, player.pos);
83:         return { type: 'projectile', damage: s.dmg, speed: s.type === 'rocket' ? 12 : 6, from: { ...this.pos }, dir: d };
84:       }
85:       case 'arc': {
86:         const d = dirTo(this.pos, player.pos);
87:         return { type: 'arc', damage: s.dmg, from: { ...this.pos }, dir: d };
88:       }
89:       default:
90:         return null;
91:     }
92:   }
93: 
94:   update(dt, player, grid) {
95:     if (this.dead) { this.deathT += dt; return null; }
96:     this.timer += dt;
97:     this.animT += dt;
98:     this.attackCooldown = max(0, this.attackCooldown - dt);
99: 
100:     // WHY: pain interrompe ação; ao terminar, retoma chase se ainda vê o player
101:     if (this.state === 'pain') {
102:       this.painTimer -= dt;
103:       if (this.painTimer <= 0) {
104:         this.setState(this.canSee(grid, player) ? 'chase' : 'idle');
105:       }
106:       return null;
107:     }
108: 
109:     const seen = this.canSee(grid, player);
110:     const dist = hypot(player.pos.x - this.pos.x, player.pos.z - this.pos.z);
111: 
112:     if (this.state === 'idle') {
113:       if (seen) this.setState('chase');
114:       return null;
115:     }
116: 
117:     if (this.state === 'chase') {
118:       if (!seen) { this.setState('idle'); return null; }
119:       const d = dirTo(this.pos, player.pos);
120:       this.yaw = Math.atan2(d.x, d.z);
121:       // WHY: moveAxis usa grid {x,y} (x=col, y=row) — traduz de/para {x,z} (lição W3)
122:       const gp = { x: this.pos.x, y: this.pos.z };
123:       const v = { x: d.x * this.stats.speed, y: d.z * this.stats.speed };
124:       const rX = moveAxis(gp, v, 'x', dt, grid, this.stats.size * 0.45);
125:       const rZ = moveAxis(rX.pos, { x: rX.vel.x, y: rX.vel.y }, 'y', dt, grid, this.stats.size * 0.45);
126:       this.pos.x = rZ.pos.x;
127:       this.pos.z = rZ.pos.y;
128:       const dist2 = hypot(player.pos.x - this.pos.x, player.pos.z - this.pos.z);
129:       if (dist2 <= this.attackRange && this.attackCooldown <= 0) this.setState('attack');
130:       return null;
131:     }
132: 
133:     if (this.state === 'attack') {
134:       // WHY: ataque é transiente — dispara uma vez e volta a chase
135:       this.attackCooldown = this.attackRate();
136:       const evt = this.fireAt(player, grid);
137:       this.setState(seen ? 'chase' : 'idle');
138:       return evt;
139:     }
140: 
141:     return null;
142:   }
143: }
144: 
145: // WHY: spawn na ARENA (17,40) — longe do spawn do player (18,22), ~18 tiles >
146: // sightRange 12; antes (17,24) ficava a 2 tiles: os 6 imps atacavam na hora e o
147: // player morria em ~3s (bug reportado). A arena é o combate final antes dos exits.
148: const spawnEnemies = (level, kind = 'imp', count = 6, center = { x: 17, z: 40 }) => {
149:   const out = [];
150:   for (let dz = 0; dz < 3 && out.length < count; dz++) {
151:     for (let dx = 0; dx < 3 && out.length < count; dx++) {
152:       const x = center.x + dx;
153:       const z = center.z + dz;
154:       if (z < 0 || z >= level.grid.length || x < 0 || x >= level.grid[0].length) continue;
155:       const tile = level.grid[z][x];
156:       if (tile === C.TILES.WALL || tile === C.TILES.DOOR) continue;
157:       out.push(new Enemy(kind, x + 0.5, z + 0.5, level.doors));
158:     }
159:   }
160:   return out;
161: };
162: 
163: export { Enemy, spawnEnemies };

(End of file - total 163 lines)

1: // js/particles.js — W5: sistema de partículas (explosões, sangue, sparkles)
2: // Dados puros + render Canvas2D com ctx injetado (testável em node)
3: 
4: // WHY: converte 0xRRGGBB para css (#rrggbb) — canvas precisa string
5: const hexToCss = (n) => `#${n.toString(16).padStart(6, '0')}`;
6: 
7: class Particle {
8:   constructor(x, z, y = 0.5, opts = {}) {
9:     this.x = x;
10:     this.z = z;
11:     this.y = y;
12:     this.vx = opts.vx ?? 0;
13:     this.vz = opts.vz ?? 0;
14:     this.vy = opts.vy ?? 0;
15:     this.life = opts.life ?? 0.6;
16:     this.maxLife = this.life;
17:     this.color = opts.color ?? 0xffaa33;
18:     this.size = opts.size ?? 0.1;
19:     this.gravity = opts.gravity ?? 0;
20:   }
21: 
22:   get alive() { return this.life > 0; }
23: 
24:   update(dt) {
25:     this.life -= dt;
26:     if (!this.alive) return;
27:     this.vy += this.gravity * dt;
28:     this.x += this.vx * dt;
29:     this.z += this.vz * dt;
30:     this.y += this.vy * dt;
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: class ParticleSystem {
35:   constructor() { this.particles = []; }
36: 
37:   get aliveCount() { return this.particles.filter((p) => p.alive).length; }
38: 
39:   spawn(x, z, y, opts) { this.particles.push(new Particle(x, z, y, opts)); }
40: 
41:   // WHY: explosão radial com velocidade aleatória (fireball estilo DOOM)
42:   explosion(x, z, y = 0.5, count = 12, power = 3) {
43:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
44:       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
45:       const v = power * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7);
46:       this.spawn(x, z, y, {
47:         vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vz: Math.sin(a) * v, vy: Math.random() * 2,
48:         life: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4, color: 0xff8800, size: 0.15, gravity: -6,
49:       });
50:     }
51:   }
52: 
53:   blood(x, z, y = 0.5, count = 8) {
54:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
55:       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
56:       const v = 1 + Math.random();
57:       this.spawn(x, z, y, {
58:         vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vz: Math.sin(a) * v, vy: Math.random(),
59:         life: 0.5, color: 0xcc2222, size: 0.08, gravity: -4,
60:       });
61:     }
62:   }
63: 
64:   spark(x, z, y = 0.5, count = 5) {
65:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
66:       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
67:       const v = 2 + Math.random() * 2;
68:       this.spawn(x, z, y, {
69:         vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vz: Math.sin(a) * v, vy: Math.random() * 2,
70:         life: 0.2, color: 0xffdd44, size: 0.05,
71:       });
72:     }
73:   }
74: 
75:   update(dt) {
76:     for (const p of this.particles) p.update(dt);
77:     // WHY: remove mortos (compactação in-place — mantém aliveCount fiel)
78:     this.particles = this.particles.filter((p) => p.alive);
79:   }
80: 
81:   render(ctx, scale = 1) {
82:     for (const p of this.particles) {
83:       ctx.fillStyle = hexToCss(p.color);
84:       ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
85:       ctx.fillRect((p.x - p.size) * scale, (p.z - p.size) * scale, p.size * 2 * scale, p.size * 2 * scale);
86:     }
87:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
88:   }
89: }
90: 
91: export { Particle, ParticleSystem, hexToCss };

1: // js/main.js — W6: entry point (init, wire, start) — jogo completo
2: import C from './constants.js';
3: import { createEngine } from './engine.js';
4: import { buildLevel, cellAt } from './map.js';
5: import { Input } from './input.js';
6: import { PlayerEntity } from './player.js';
7: import { WeaponSystem } from './weapons.js';
8: import { spawnEnemies } from './enemies.js';
9: import { ParticleSystem } from './particles.js';
10: import { AudioEngine } from './audio.js';
11: import { buildMinimapData, renderMinimap } from './minimap.js';
12: import { buildHudData, renderHud } from './hud.js';
13: import { Game, STATES } from './game.js';
14: import { buildWorld, buildEnemyMeshes, buildViewmodel, createProjectileMesh, createParticleMesh } from './world.js';
15: import { raycastEnemy, meleeTarget } from './weapons.js';
16: import { knockback, cameraBob } from './move.js';
17: 
18: // WHY: monta o mundo do jogo (tudo que não depende do loop)
19: const init = () => {
20:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
21:   const engine = createEngine(canvas);
22:   engine.resize();
23:   const level = buildLevel();
24:   const input = new Input(canvas);
25:   const audio = new AudioEngine();
26:   const player = new PlayerEntity(level, input, new WeaponSystem());
27:   const enemies = spawnEnemies(level, 'imp', 6);
28:   const particles = new ParticleSystem();
29:   // WHY: buffers reais dos canvas overlay (hud = tela; minimap = 36×44 tiles × 6px)
30:   const hudCanvas = document.getElementById('hud');
31:   hudCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
32:   hudCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
33:   const mapCanvas = document.getElementById('minimap');
34:   mapCanvas.width = C.MAP.gridW * 6;
35:   mapCanvas.height = C.MAP.gridH * 6;
36:   const hudCtx = hudCanvas.getContext('2d');
37:   const mapCtx = mapCanvas.getContext('2d');
38:   return { engine, level, input, audio, player, enemies, particles, hudCtx, mapCtx, score: 0 };
39: };
40: 
41: // WHY: tela de menu/fim — texto central no canvas do HUD
42: const drawOverlay = (ctx, w, h, title, sub) => {
43:   // WHY: clearRect antes do fundo — evita ghosting do overlay anterior no canvas 2D
44:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
45:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)';
46:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
47:   ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc33';
48:   ctx.font = 'bold 28px monospace';
49:   ctx.textAlign = 'center';
50:   ctx.fillText(title, w / 2, h / 2 - 10);
51:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
52:   ctx.font = '14px monospace';
53:   ctx.fillText(sub, w / 2, h / 2 + 20);
54: };
55: 
56: // WHY: liga update/render/estados ao loop fixed-step do Game
57: const wire = (w) => {
58:   buildWorld(w.engine.world, w.level.grid);
59:   const enemyMeshes = buildEnemyMeshes(w.engine.world, w.enemies);
60:   const viewmodel = buildViewmodel(w.engine.camera);
61:   const { camera, renderer, scene } = w.engine;
62:   let lastHp = w.player.hp;
63:   let viewKick = 0; // recoil visual do viewmodel (decai no update, aplica no render)
64:   let shakeT = 0; // tremor de câmera ao tomar dano (idem)
65:   const particleMeshes = new Map(); // espelha partículas em meshes 3D (particles.js é puro)
66:   w.projectiles = [];
67: 
68:   // WHY: splash do foguete — dano a todos os inimigos na área (não ao player)
69:   const splashDamage = (x, z, radius, damage) => {
70:     for (const e of w.enemies) {
71:       if (e.dead) continue;
72:       const d = Math.hypot(e.pos.x - x, e.pos.z - z);
73:       if (d <= radius) e.damage(damage);
74:     }
75:   };
76: 
77:   // WHY: projétil do jogo com mesh visível — owner 'enemy' acerta player; 'player' acerta inimigos
78:   const pushProjectile = (from, dir, speed, damage, owner, splash = 0) => {
79:     w.projectiles.push({
80:       x: from.x, z: from.z,
81:       dir: { x: dir.x, z: dir.z },
82:       speed, damage, owner, splash,
83:       mesh: createProjectileMesh(scene, from.x, from.z),
84:     });
85:   };
86: 
87:   const update = (dt) => {
88:     if (w.game.state !== STATES.PLAYING) return;
89:     w.__updates = (w.__updates ?? 0) + 1; // WHY: contador p/ profiling fixed-step (E2E)
90:     w.player.update(dt);
91:     // WHY: animação das portas — fecha (y=1.1) ou afunda no chão (y=-1.0) suavemente
92:     const doorMeshes = w.engine.world.userData.doorMeshes;
93:     for (const d of w.level.doors) {
94:       const m = doorMeshes.get(`${d.x},${d.z}`);
95:       if (!m) continue;
96:       const target = d.state === 'open' ? -1.0 : 1.1;
97:       m.position.y += (target - m.position.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
98:     }
99:     for (const e of w.enemies) {
100:       const evt = e.update(dt, w.player, w.level.grid);
101:       // WHY: lunge visual — dispara junto com o ataque (decai no bloco de animação)
102:       if (evt && evt.damage > 0) e.attackAnim = 0.25;
103:       // WHY: melee/hitscan = dano direto; projectile/double/arc = projétil visível
104:       if (evt && evt.damage > 0) {
105:         if (evt.type === 'melee') {
106:           w.player.damage(evt.damage);
107:           knockback(w.player.vel, evt.from.x - w.player.pos.x, evt.from.z - w.player.pos.z, 2.5);
108:         } else if (evt.type === 'hitscan') {
109:           w.player.damage(evt.damage);
110:         } else if (evt.type === 'double') {
111:           const a = { x: evt.dir.x, z: evt.dir.z };
112:           const rot = (s) => ({ x: a.x * Math.cos(s) - a.z * Math.sin(s), z: a.x * Math.sin(s) + a.z * Math.cos(s) });
113:           pushProjectile(evt.from, rot(0.12), evt.speed ?? 6, evt.damage, 'enemy');
114:           pushProjectile(evt.from, rot(-0.12), evt.speed ?? 6, evt.damage, 'enemy');
115:         } else {
116:           pushProjectile(evt.from, evt.dir, evt.speed ?? 6, evt.damage, 'enemy');
117:         }
118:       }
119:       // WHY: score só na transição viva→morta — antes somava +10 todo frame (infinito)
120:       if (e.dead && !e.scored) { e.scored = true; w.score += 10; }
121:       const mesh = enemyMeshes.get(e);
122:       if (mesh) {
123:         if (e.dead) {
124:           // WHY: morte animada (queda) em vez de pop — leva 0.5s tombando e afundando
125:           const k = Math.min(1, e.deathT / 0.5);
126:           mesh.rotation.x = -k * (Math.PI / 2) * 0.9;
127:           mesh.position.y = e.stats.size * 0.8 * (1 - k * 0.7);
128:           mesh.position.set(e.pos.x, mesh.position.y, e.pos.z);
129:           if (e.deathT >= 0.6 && mesh.parent) w.engine.world.remove(mesh);
130:         } else {
131:           // WHY: yaw aponta pro player (FSM já calcula) — mesh rotaciona para "olhar"
132:           mesh.rotation.y = e.yaw;
133:           // WHY: bob de caminhada (chase) vs respiração idle — animT avança sempre
134:           const moving = e.state === 'chase' || e.state === 'attack';
135:           const bob = moving
136:             ? Math.abs(Math.sin(e.animT * 9)) * e.stats.size * 0.16
137:             : Math.sin(e.animT * 2) * e.stats.size * 0.05;
138:           mesh.position.set(e.pos.x, e.stats.size * 0.8 + bob, e.pos.z);
139:           // WHY: dor — flash emissive + treme; ataque — lunges na direção do player
140:           const flash = e.painTimer > 0 ? 1.1 : 0.28;
141:           for (const c of mesh.children) {
142:             if (c.material && c.material.emissiveIntensity !== undefined) c.material.emissiveIntensity = flash;
143:           }
144:           if (e.attackAnim > 0) {
145:             e.attackAnim -= dt;
146:             const dx = w.player.pos.x - e.pos.x;
147:             const dz = w.player.pos.z - e.pos.z;
148:             const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
149:             mesh.position.x += (dx / len) * e.attackAnim * 2;
150:             mesh.position.z += (dz / len) * e.attackAnim * 2;
151:           }
152:         }
153:       }
154:     }
155:     // WHY: projéteis — mover, colidir (parede/player/inimigo), dano + splash no impacto
156:     for (let i = w.projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
157:       const p = w.projectiles[i];
158:       p.x += p.dir.x * p.speed * dt;
159:       p.z += p.dir.z * p.speed * dt;
160:       const tile = cellAt(w.level.grid, Math.floor(p.x), Math.floor(p.z));
161:       if (tile === C.TILES.WALL || tile === C.TILES.DOOR) {
162:         if (p.splash > 0) splashDamage(p.x, p.z, p.splash, p.damage);
163:         w.particles.spark(p.x, p.z, 0.5, 5);
164:         w.engine.world.remove(p.mesh);
165:         w.projectiles.splice(i, 1);
166:         continue;
167:       }
168:       if (p.owner === 'enemy') {
169:         const dx = p.x - w.player.pos.x;
170:         const dz = p.z - w.player.pos.z;
171:         if (dx * dx + dz * dz < 0.36) {
172:           w.player.damage(p.damage);
173:           knockback(w.player.vel, p.dir.x, p.dir.z, 2.5);
174:           w.engine.world.remove(p.mesh);
175:           w.projectiles.splice(i, 1);
176:           continue;
177:         }
178:       } else {
179:         let hit = null;
180:         for (const e of w.enemies) {
181:           if (e.dead) continue;
182:           const dx = p.x - e.pos.x;
183:           const dz = p.z - e.pos.z;
184:           const r = e.stats.size * 0.6;
185:           if (dx * dx + dz * dz < r * r) { hit = e; break; }
186:         }
187:         if (hit) {
188:           hit.damage(p.damage);
189:           // WHY: VFX no impacto — sangue no alvo; explosão real se tiver splash
190:           w.particles.blood(hit.pos.x, hit.pos.z, hit.stats.size * 0.7, 6);
191:           if (p.splash > 0) { splashDamage(p.x, p.z, p.splash, p.damage); w.particles.explosion(p.x, p.z, 0.5, 14, 4); }
192:           w.audio.play('explosion');
193:           w.engine.world.remove(p.mesh);
194:           w.projectiles.splice(i, 1);
195:           continue;
196:         }
197:       }
198:       p.mesh.position.set(p.x, 0.35, p.z);
199:     }
200:     w.particles.update(dt);
201:     // WHY: partículas 3D — espelha as vivas em meshes, remove meshes das mortas
202:     // (particles.js é puro/dados; o espelho vive aqui para não acoplar THREE)
203:     for (const [p, m] of particleMeshes) {
204:       if (!p.alive || !w.particles.particles.includes(p)) {
205:         scene.remove(m);
206:         particleMeshes.delete(p);
207:       }
208:     }
209:     for (const p of w.particles.particles) {
210:       let m = particleMeshes.get(p);
211:       if (!m) { m = createParticleMesh(scene, p.color, p.size); particleMeshes.set(p, m); }
212:       m.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
213:     }
214:     // WHY: decay dos efeitos de tela — recoil e shake voltam a zero sozinhos
215:     viewKick = Math.max(0, viewKick - dt * 5);
216:     shakeT = Math.max(0, shakeT - dt * 2);
217:     // WHY: dano no player — shake de câmera + sangue (antes só som)
218:     if (w.player.hp < lastHp) {
219:       w.audio.play('damage');
220:       shakeT = 0.35;
221:       w.particles.blood(w.player.pos.x, w.player.pos.z, 0.6, 6);
222:     }
223:     lastHp = w.player.hp;
224:     // WHY: condições de fim — morte (lava/inimigos) ou saída (exit)
225:     if (w.player.hp <= 0) { w.game.gameOver(); w.audio.play('explosion'); return; }
226:     const tile = cellAt(w.level.grid, Math.floor(w.player.pos.x), Math.floor(w.player.pos.z));
227:     if (tile === C.TILES.EXIT) { w.game.win(); w.audio.play('pickup'); }
228:   };
229: 
230:   const render = () => {
231:     const hw = w.hudCtx.canvas.width;
232:     const hh = w.hudCtx.canvas.height;
233:     const st = w.game.state;
234:     if (st === STATES.MENU) { drawOverlay(w.hudCtx, hw, hh, 'DOOM CLONE', 'clique para jogar'); return; }
235:     if (st === STATES.GAMEOVER) { drawOverlay(w.hudCtx, hw, hh, 'VOCÊ MORREU', 'clique para tentar de novo'); return; }
236:     if (st === STATES.WIN) { drawOverlay(w.hudCtx, hw, hh, 'NÍVEL COMPLETO', `score ${w.score} — clique para jogar`); return; }
237:     if (st === STATES.PAUSED) { drawOverlay(w.hudCtx, hw, hh, 'PAUSA', 'P para continuar'); return; }
238:     // WHY: câmera FPS — posição + bob de caminhada + yaw/pitch do input
239:     camera.position.set(w.player.pos.x, w.player.viewY(), w.player.pos.z);
240:     camera.rotation.order = 'YXZ';
241:     camera.rotation.y = -w.player.yaw;
242:     camera.rotation.x = w.player.pitch;
243:     // WHY: shake de tela ao tomar dano — deslocamento aleatório (decai no update)
244:     if (shakeT > 0) {
245:       camera.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeT * 0.4;
246:       camera.position.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeT * 0.3;
247:     }
248:     // WHY: viewmodel — 1 mesh visível por arma; recoil (kick) recua/sobe a arma,
249:     // soco avança; bob do grupo amplifica o da câmera p/ sensação de peso
250:     const activeKey = w.player.weapons.key;
251:     const bob = cameraBob(w.player.bobTime, w.player.isMoving(), 1);
252:     for (const [key, mesh] of viewmodel) {
253:       mesh.visible = key === activeKey;
254:       if (!mesh.visible) continue;
255:       const isFist = key === 'fist';
256:       mesh.position.set(
257:         bob.x * 2.5,
258:         bob.y * 2.5,
259:         isFist ? -viewKick * 0.5 : viewKick * 0.25,
260:       );
261:       mesh.rotation.x = isFist ? -viewKick * 1.1 : viewKick * 0.9;
262:     }
263:     renderer.render(scene, camera);
264:     // WHY: HUD retro + minimap (overlays 2D)
265:     renderHud(w.hudCtx, buildHudData({ ...w.player, score: w.score }, w.player.weapons), hw, hh);
266:     renderMinimap(w.mapCtx, buildMinimapData(w.level, w.player, w.enemies, w.level.pickups), 6);
267:   };
268: 
269:   w.game = new Game({ update, render });
270:   w.audio.ensureCtx(); // autoplay policy: contexto criado no gesto do usuário
271:   document.getElementById('game').addEventListener('click', () => {
272:     if (w.game.state === STATES.MENU || w.game.state === STATES.GAMEOVER || w.game.state === STATES.WIN) {
273:       w.player.start();
274:       w.game.startGame();
275:     }
276:   });
277:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
278:     if (e.code === 'KeyP') w.game.togglePause();
279:     // WHY: W8 — troca de arma (1-4) estava desconectada do browser
280:     const slot = ['Digit1', 'Digit2', 'Digit3', 'Digit4'].indexOf(e.code);
281:     if (slot !== -1 && w.game.state === STATES.PLAYING) w.player.weapons.switchWeapon(slot);
282:   });
283:   // WHY: W8 — tiro no mousedown; W9 — combate real: hitscan/spread/melee acertam
284:   // inimigos (raycastEnemy/meleeTarget); rocket vira projétil com dano no impacto
285:   document.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
286:     if (e.button !== 0 || w.game.state !== STATES.PLAYING) return;
287:     const evt = w.player.weapons.fire(w.player, w.level.grid);
288:     if (!evt) return;
289:     // WHY: kick do viewmodel por arma — fist avança (negativo), armas recuam (positivo)
290:     viewKick = evt.type === 'melee' ? 0.9 : 0.6;
291:     if (evt.type === 'melee') {
292:       const t = meleeTarget(w.player, w.enemies, evt.range);
293:       if (t) { t.damage(evt.damage); w.audio.play('damage'); w.particles.blood(t.pos.x, t.pos.z, t.stats.size * 0.7, 6); }
294:     } else if (evt.type === 'hitscan') {
295:       const t = raycastEnemy(w.player, w.level.grid, w.enemies, evt.hit.dist);
296:       if (t) { t.damage(evt.damage); w.audio.play('damage'); w.particles.blood(t.pos.x, t.pos.z, t.stats.size * 0.7, 6); }
297:     } else if (evt.type === 'spread') {
298:       for (const pellet of evt.pellets) {
299:         const t = raycastEnemy(w.player, w.level.grid, w.enemies, pellet.dist);
300:         if (t) { t.damage(evt.damage); w.audio.play('damage'); w.particles.blood(t.pos.x, t.pos.z, t.stats.size * 0.5, 4); }
301:       }
302:     } else if (evt.type === 'projectile') {
303:       const dir = { x: evt.proj.dx, z: evt.proj.dz };
304:       pushProjectile(w.player.pos, dir, evt.proj.speed, evt.damage, 'player', evt.splash ?? 0);
305:     }
306:   });

308:   w.game.start();
309:   // WHY: hook de teste E2E — Playwright lê/teleporta estado sem expor API pública
310:   // WHY: viewKick via getter (closure) p/ o E2E provar o recoil sem API pública
311:   Object.defineProperty(w, 'viewKick', { get: () => viewKick, configurable: true });
312:   window.__doom = w;
313:   return w;

1: // js/move.js — física pura para DOOM clone
2: // Sem dependências, testável em node
3: 
4: import C from './constants.js';
5: import { R_y, clamp } from './utils.js';
6: 
7: // WHY: aplica gravidade ao vetor de velocidade (clamp só no limite inferior — não corta pulo)
8: const applyGravity = (vel, dt) => {
9:   vel.y += C.PHYSICS.gravity * dt;
10:   if (vel.y < C.PHYSICS.maxFall) vel.y = C.PHYSICS.maxFall;
11:   return vel;
12: };
13: 
14: // WHY: aplica atrito ou resistência do ar
15: const applyFriction = (vel, dt, onGround) => {
16:   if (onGround) {
17:     vel.x *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.friction * dt;
18:     vel.z *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.friction * dt;
19:   } else {
20:     vel.x *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.airResist * dt;
21:     vel.z *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.airResist * dt;
22:   }
23:   return vel;
24: };
25: 
26: // WHY: acelera o jogador na direção desejada
27: const accelerate = (vel, wishdir, accel, dt) => {
28:   vel.x += wishdir.x * accel * dt;
29:   vel.z += wishdir.z * accel * dt;
30:   return vel;
31: };
32: 
33: // WHY: move e resolve colisão AABB por eixo — checa a área varrida inteira
34: // WHY: isSolid opcional — default só parede (WALL); player/enemy passam callback
35: // que também trata porta fechada como sólida (sem ele, porta fechada é atravessável)
36: const moveAxis = (pos, vel, axis, dt, grid, radius, isSolid = null) => {
37:   const newVel = { ...vel };
38:   const newPos = { ...pos };
39: 
40:   // WHY: eixo complementar (y é o eixo "outro" nos testes 2D)
41:   const other = axis === 'x' ? 'y' : 'x';
42:   const oldMain = pos[axis];
43:   const oldOther = pos[other];
44:   const newMain = oldMain + vel[axis] * dt;
45:   const newOther = oldOther + vel[other] * dt;
46: 
47:   // WHY: faixa varrida pelo AABB do centro antigo ao novo (+radius)
48:   const lo = Math.floor(Math.min(oldMain, newMain) - radius);
49:   const hi = Math.floor(Math.max(oldMain, newMain) + radius);
50:   const oLo = Math.floor(oldOther - radius);
51:   const oHi = Math.floor(newOther + radius);
52: 
53:   // WHY: fora do grid = parede (nunca `grid[r][c]` com r/c fora — isso lançaria
54:   // TypeError e mataria o rAF; o knockback do W9 empurra o player até a borda)
55:   const isWall = (r, c) => r < 0 || r >= grid.length || c < 0 || c >= grid[0].length || grid[r][c] === C.TILES.WALL;
56:   const solid = isSolid ?? isWall;
57:   let collided = false;
58:   for (let a = lo; a <= hi && !collided; a++) {
59:     for (let b = oLo; b <= oHi; b++) {
60:       const cell = axis === 'x' ? solid(b, a) : solid(a, b);
61:       if (cell) { collided = true; break; }
62:     }
63:   }
64: 
65:   if (collided) {
66:     newVel[axis] = 0;
67:     newPos[axis] = oldMain;
68:   } else {
69:     newPos[axis] = newMain;
70:     newPos[other] = newOther;
71:   }
72: 
73:   return { pos: newPos, vel: newVel, collided };
74: };
75: 
76: // WHY: aplica pulo quando no chão
77: const tryJump = (vel, onGround) => {
78:   if (onGround) vel.y = C.PHYSICS.jumpVel;
79:   return vel;
80: };
81: 
82: // WHY: aplica knockback ao jogador
83: const knockback = (vel, dirX, dirZ, force) => {
84:   vel.x += dirX * force * C.PHYSICS.BOUNCE;
85:   vel.z += dirZ * force * C.PHYSICS.BOUNCE;
86:   return vel;
87: };
88: 
89: // WHY: calcula dano de splash por distância
90: const splashDamage = (damage, dist, radius) => {
91:   if (dist > radius) return 0;
92:   if (dist === 0) return damage;
93:   return damage * (1 - dist / radius);
94: };
95: 
96: // WHY: bobbing da câmera
97: const cameraBob = (time, moving, speed) => {
98:   const bobAmp = C.PHYSICS.bobAmp;
99:   const bobFreq = C.PHYSICS.bobFreq;
100:   if (!moving) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
101:   return {
102:     x: Math.sin(time * bobFreq) * bobAmp,
103:     y: Math.sin(time * bobFreq * 2) * bobAmp * 0.5,
104:   };
105: };
106: 
107: export {
108:   applyGravity,
109:   applyFriction,
110:   accelerate,
111:   moveAxis,
112:   tryJump,
113:   knockback,
114:   splashDamage,
115:   cameraBob,
116: };

1: // js/world.js — construção da geometria 3D do mapa (fonte única: preview + main)
2: // Referências de arte: Duke Nukem 3D (texturas de tijolo/metal, viewmodels grandes),
3: // Quake (teto presente, materiais com rugosidade, luz direcional), Black PS2
4: // (iluminação dramática, olhos/emissivos brilhando no escuro), CS (silhuetas legíveis).
5: import * as THREE from '../vendor/three.module.js';
6: import C from './constants.js';
7: 
8: // WHY: texturas procedurais geradas 1x por canvas (sem assets externos, sem rede).
9: // Lazy: só no browser (buildWorld) — testes unit em node não importam este módulo.
10: const texCache = new Map();
11: const makeTexture = (name, w, h, paint) => {
12:   if (texCache.has(name)) return texCache.get(name);
13:   const c = document.createElement('canvas');
14:   c.width = w;
15:   c.height = h;
16:   const g = c.getContext('2d');
17:   paint(g, w, h);
18:   const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
19:   t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
20:   texCache.set(name, t);
21:   return t;
22: };
23: 
24: // WHY: ruído determinístico (semente fixa) — variação de tom sem flicker entre frames
25: const seededRand = (n) => {
26:   let s = n * 9301 + 49297;
27:   s = (s * 233280) % 233280;
28:   return s / 233280;
29: };
30: 
31: // WHY: bump map procedural (grayscale: branco = relevo alto, preto = fundo) —
32: // dá profundidade real às superfícies (tijolo saliente, junta funda) sem assets
33: const makeBump = (name, w, h, paint) => {
34:   const key = `bump:${name}`;
35:   if (texCache.has(key)) return texCache.get(key);
36:   const c = document.createElement('canvas');
37:   c.width = w;
38:   c.height = h;
39:   const g = c.getContext('2d');
40:   paint(g, w, h);
41:   const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
42:   t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
43:   texCache.set(key, t);
44:   return t;
45: };
46: 
47: // WHY: tijolo 64×32 com argamassa, sombreamento topo-base por tijolo (luz de cima)
48: // e variação de tom — Duke/Quake; bump: tijolo alto, junta funda
49: const wallTex = () => makeTexture('wall', 128, 128, (g, w, h) => {
50:   g.fillStyle = '#2e241c';
51:   g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
52:   const bw = 64, bh = 32;
53:   for (let y = 0; y < h; y += bh) {
54:     const off = (y / bh) % 2 === 0 ? 0 : bw / 2;
55:     for (let x = -bw / 2; x < w; x += bw) {
56:       const v = seededRand(x * 7 + y * 13) * 30;
57:       const r = 162 + v, g2 = 112 + v * 0.6, b = 78 + v * 0.4;
58:       // sombreamento topo→base (luz vinda de cima — forma cilíndrica do tijolo)
59:       const grad = g.createLinearGradient(0, y + 2, 0, y + bh - 2);
60:       grad.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${(r * 1.18) | 0},${(g2 * 1.15) | 0},${(b * 1.1) | 0})`);

1: // js/audio.js — W5: WebAudio procedural (6 sons + música) — zero arquivos externos
2: // AudioContext injetável: browser real ou null (node/tests) — estado sempre rastreável
3: 
4: // WHY: sons sintetizados via osciladores + slide de frequência — requisito "sem arquivos"
5: const SOUNDS = {
6:   shoot: { type: 'square', freq: 440, dur: 0.08, slide: -200 },
7:   enemyShoot: { type: 'sawtooth', freq: 220, dur: 0.1, slide: -80 },
8:   damage: { type: 'triangle', freq: 180, dur: 0.15, slide: -60 },
9:   pickup: { type: 'sine', freq: 660, dur: 0.12, slide: 220 },
10:   door: { type: 'square', freq: 90, dur: 0.2, slide: -30 },
11:   explosion: { type: 'sawtooth', freq: 120, dur: 0.35, slide: -90 },
12: };
13: 
14: class AudioEngine {
15:   constructor(ctx = null) {
16:     this.ctx = ctx;
17:     this.muted = false;
18:     this.lastPlayed = null;
19:     this.queue = [];
20:     this.musicPlaying = false;
21:   }
22: 
23:   // WHY: cria o contexto sob demanda (autoplay policy do browser exige gesto do usuário)
24:   ensureCtx() {
25:     if (this.ctx) return this.ctx;
26:     if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.AudioContext) {
27:       this.ctx = new window.AudioContext();
28:     }
29:     return this.ctx;
30:   }
31: 
32:   play(name) {
33:     this.lastPlayed = name;
34:     this.queue.push(name);
35:     const s = SOUNDS[name];
36:     if (!s) return false;
37:     const ctx = this.ensureCtx();
38:     if (!ctx || this.muted) return false;
39:     const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
40:     const gain = ctx.createGain();
41:     osc.type = s.type;
42:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(s.freq, ctx.currentTime);
43:     osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, s.freq + s.slide), ctx.currentTime + s.dur);
44:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, ctx.currentTime);
45:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + s.dur);
46:     osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
47:     osc.start(ctx.currentTime);
48:     osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + s.dur);
49:     return true;
50:   }
51: 
52:   setMuted(m) { this.muted = m; }
53: 
54:   toggleMute() { this.muted = !this.muted; return this.muted; }
55: 
56:   startMusic() { this.musicPlaying = true; }
57: 
58:   stopMusic() { this.musicPlaying = false; }
59: 
60:   // WHY: escala pentatônica menor — notas válidas para música procedural
61:   static scaleNote(i) {
62:     const root = 110;
63:     const steps = [0, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12];
64:     return root * Math.pow(2, steps[i % steps.length] / 12);
65:   }
66: }
67: 
68: export { AudioEngine, SOUNDS };

1: // js/player.js — PlayerEntity (W3): FSM MENU/PLAYING, física, bob, pickups
2: import C from './constants.js';
3: import {
4:   applyGravity,
5:   applyFriction,
6:   accelerate,
7:   moveAxis,
8:   tryJump,
9:   cameraBob,
10: } from './move.js';
11: 
12: const { floor, min, max } = Math;
13: 
14: class PlayerEntity {
15:   constructor(level, input, weapons) {
16:     const s = level.playerSpawn;
17:     // WHY: centro do tile (spawn.x/z são índices inteiros do grid)
18:     this.pos = { x: s.x + 0.5, z: s.z + 0.5 };
19:     this.y = 0;
20:     this.vel = { x: 0, z: 0, y: 0 };
21:     this.yaw = s.yaw ?? -Math.PI / 2;
22:     this.pitch = 0;
23:     this.hp = C.PLAYER.startHp;
24:     this.armor = C.PLAYER.startArmor;
25:     this.onGround = true;
26:     this.state = 'MENU'; // FSM: MENU -> PLAYING
27:     this.bobTime = 0;
28:     this.input = input;
29:     this.weapons = weapons;
30:     this.level = level;
31:   }
32: 
33:   // WHY: FSM — transições explícitas (lição 5: compare uppercase, comente cada transição)
34:   start() { this.state = 'PLAYING'; }
35:   pause() { this.state = 'MENU'; }
36: 
37:   isMoving() {
38:     return Math.abs(this.vel.x) > 0.05 || Math.abs(this.vel.z) > 0.05;
39:   }
40: 
41:   update(dt) {
42:     if (this.state !== 'PLAYING') return;
43:     // WHY: cooldown das armas avança com o tempo de jogo (W8 — sem isso o browser
44:     // nunca decrementava o cooldown e canFire() ficava false após o 1º tiro)
45:     this.weapons.update(dt);
46:     this.handleDoors(dt);
47:     const wish = this.input.getAxis();
48:     const yaw = this.input.yaw;
49: 
50:     // WHY: R_y(-yaw) — câmera usa rotation.y = -yaw, então frente = (sin yaw, -cos yaw);
51:     // R_y(+yaw) deixava W/S invertidos em relação à câmera (bug "teclas WS invertidas")
52:     const wishX = -wish.z * Math.sin(yaw) + wish.x * Math.cos(yaw);
53:     const wishZ = wish.z * Math.cos(yaw) + wish.x * Math.sin(yaw);
54: 
55:     const speed = this.input.isDown('ShiftLeft') ? C.PHYSICS.runSpeed : C.PHYSICS.walkSpeed;
56:     accelerate(this.vel, { x: wishX, z: wishZ }, C.PHYSICS.accel * speed, dt);
57:     applyFriction(this.vel, dt, this.onGround);
58:     if (this.input.isDown('Space')) tryJump(this.vel, this.onGround);
59:     applyGravity(this.vel, dt);
60: 
61:     // WHY: colisão horizontal por eixo — moveAxis usa pos {x,y} do grid 2D,
62:     // então traduzimos para {x: col, y: row} e de volta para pos {x,z}
63:     // WHY: isSolid — porta FECHADA bloqueia (WALL + DOOR fechada); aberta deixa passar
64:     const isSolid = (r, c) => {
65:       const out = r < 0 || r >= this.level.grid.length || c < 0 || c >= this.level.grid[0].length || this.level.grid[r][c] === C.TILES.WALL;
66:       if (out) return true;
67:       if (this.level.grid[r][c] !== C.TILES.DOOR) return false;
68:       const door = this.level.doors.find((d) => d.x === c && d.z === r);
69:       return !door || door.state !== 'open';
70:     };
71:     const gp = { x: this.pos.x, y: this.pos.z };
72:     const rX = moveAxis(gp, { x: this.vel.x, y: this.vel.z }, 'x', dt, this.level.grid, C.PLAYER.radius, isSolid);
73:     const rZ = moveAxis(rX.pos, { x: rX.vel.x, y: rX.vel.y }, 'y', dt, this.level.grid, C.PLAYER.radius, isSolid);
74:     this.pos.x = rZ.pos.x;
75:     this.pos.z = rZ.pos.y;
76:     this.vel.x = rZ.vel.x;
77:     this.vel.z = rZ.vel.y;
78: 
79:     // WHY: altura vertical — chão em y=0, sem teto no mapa
80:     this.y += this.vel.y * dt;
81:     if (this.y <= 0) {
82:       this.y = 0;
83:       this.vel.y = 0;
84:       this.onGround = true;
85:     } else if (this.vel.y !== 0) {
86:       this.onGround = false;
87:     }
88: 
89:     if (this.isMoving()) this.bobTime += dt;
90:     this.yaw = yaw;
91:     this.pitch = this.input.pitch;
92: 
93:     this.stepHazards(dt);
94:     this.collectPickups();
95:   }
96: 
97:   // WHY: portas — E alterna a porta mais próxima (≤ 1.6 tiles); aberta fecha
98:   // sozinha após 3s (auto-close), fechada bloqueia movimento via isSolid no moveAxis
99:   handleDoors(dt) {
100:     for (const d of this.level.doors) {
101:       if (d.state === 'open') {
102:         d.openT -= dt;
103:         if (d.openT <= 0) d.state = 'closed';
104:       }
105:     }
106:     if (!this.input.justPressed.has('KeyE')) return;
107:     this.input.consume('KeyE');
108:     let best = null;
109:     let bestD = 1.6;
110:     for (const d of this.level.doors) {
111:       const dist = Math.hypot(d.x + 0.5 - this.pos.x, d.z + 0.5 - this.pos.z);
112:       if (dist < bestD) { best = d; bestD = dist; }
113:     }
114:     if (best) {
115:       best.state = best.state === 'closed' ? 'open' : 'closed';
116:       best.openT = best.state === 'open' ? 3 : 0;
117:     }
118:   }
119: 
120:   // WHY: lava causa dano contínuo (tile LAVA do grid)
121:   // WHY: guard de bounds — se o player sair do grid (knockback extremo), grid[z] é
122:   // undefined e `undefined[x]` lançaria TypeError, matando o rAF (jogo congela)
123:   stepHazards(dt) {
124:     const row = this.level.grid[floor(this.pos.z)];
125:     const tile = row ? row[floor(this.pos.x)] : undefined;
126:     if (tile === C.TILES.LAVA) this.damage(12 * dt);
127:   }
128: 
129:   collectPickups() {
130:     const remaining = [];
131:     for (const p of this.level.pickups) {
132:       const d = Math.hypot(p.x + 0.5 - this.pos.x, p.z + 0.5 - this.pos.z);
133:       if (d < 0.6) {
134:         if (p.type === C.TILES.HEALTH) this.hp = min(C.PLAYER.startHp, this.hp + 25);
135:         else if (p.type === C.TILES.ARMOR) this.armor = min(100, this.armor + 25);
136:         // WHY: W9 — pickup W desbloqueia arma nova (shotgun → rocket) e SEMPRE dá
137:         // munição; antes só dava munição e o inventário já vinha completo (DOOM clássico)
138:         else if (p.type === C.TILES.WEAPON) {
139:           if (!this.weapons.inventory.includes('shotgun')) this.weapons.unlockWeapon('shotgun');
140:           else if (!this.weapons.inventory.includes('rocket')) this.weapons.unlockWeapon('rocket');
141:           this.weapons.addAmmo('all', 20);
142:         }
143:       } else {
144:         remaining.push(p);
145:       }
146:     }
147:     this.level.pickups = remaining;
148:   }
149: 
150:   // WHY: armadura absorve 50% do dano antes do HP (DOOM clássico)
151:   // WHY: sem Math.round — dano contínuo (lava 12*dt com dt<1/12) seria anulado
152:   damage(amount) {
153:     if (this.armor > 0) {
154:       const absorbed = min(this.armor, amount * 0.5);
155:       this.armor -= absorbed;
156:       amount -= absorbed;
157:     }
158:     this.hp = max(0, this.hp - amount);
159:     return this.hp;
160:   }
161: 
162:   viewY() {
163:     return C.PLAYER.height + cameraBob(this.bobTime, this.isMoving(), 1).y;
164:   }
165: }
166: 
167: export { PlayerEntity };

167:     // WHY: sightRange é atributo de instância do Enemy (12) — não existe em C.ENEMY

1: // js/weapons.js — WeaponSystem (W3): Fist, Pistol, Shotgun, Rocket + munição
2: import C from './constants.js';
3: import { hasLineOfSight } from './map.js';
4: 
5: const { floor, min, hypot } = Math;
6: 
7: // WHY: slots fixos de arma (teclas 1-4) — o inventário é desbloqueável (W9)
8: const SLOTS = ['fist', 'pistol', 'shotgun', 'rocket'];
9: 
10: // WHY: raycast DDA contra o grid (hitscan/spread) — retorna ponto de impacto
11: const raycast = (player, grid, spread = 0) => {
12:   const yaw = player.yaw + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spread;
13:   const dx = Math.sin(yaw);
14:   const dz = Math.cos(yaw);
15:   let x = player.pos.x;
16:   let z = player.pos.z;
17:   let dist = 0;
18:   while (dist < 60) {
19:     x += dx * 0.05;
20:     z += dz * 0.05;
21:     dist += 0.05;
22:     const tx = floor(x);
23:     const tz = floor(z);
24:     if (tx < 0 || tz < 0 || tx >= C.MAP.gridW || tz >= C.MAP.gridH) break;
25:     const tile = grid[tz][tx];
26:     if (tile === C.TILES.WALL || tile === C.TILES.DOOR) {
27:       return { x, z, dist, hit: true, tile };
28:     }
29:   }
30:   return { x, z, dist, hit: false, tile: null };
31: };
32: 
33: class WeaponSystem {
34:   constructor() {
35:     // WHY: inventário começa só com fist+pistol; shotgun/rocket são desbloqueados
36:     // pelos pickups W (DOOM clássico — antes todas as 4 armas já vinham "equipadas",
37:     // então "armas não apareciam" e o pickup W só dava munição)
38:     this.inventory = ['fist', 'pistol'];
39:     this.current = 0;
40:     this.ammo = { fist: Infinity, pistol: 50, shotgun: 12, rocket: 4 };
41:     this.cooldown = 0;
42:   }
43: 
44:   get weapon() { return C.WEAPON[this.inventory[this.current]]; }
45:   get name() { return this.weapon.name; }
46:   get key() { return this.inventory[this.current]; }
47: 
48:   // WHY: desbloqueia arma (pickup W) e equipa automaticamente (DOOM clássico)
49:   unlockWeapon(key) {
50:     if (!C.WEAPON[key]) return false;
51:     if (!this.inventory.includes(key)) {
52:       this.inventory.push(key);
53:       this.current = this.inventory.length - 1;
54:     }
55:     return true;
56:   }
57: 
58:   update(dt) {
59:     this.cooldown = Math.max(0, this.cooldown - dt);
60:   }
61: 
62:   canFire() {
63:     const w = this.weapon;
64:     return this.cooldown <= 0 && (this.key === 'fist' || this.ammo[this.key] >= w.ammoCost);
65:   }
66: 
67:   // WHY: switch por SLOT fixo (1-4) — arma não-desbloqueada não troca (W9)
68:   switchWeapon(slot) {
69:     const key = SLOTS[slot];
70:     if (key && this.inventory.includes(key)) this.current = this.inventory.indexOf(key);
71:   }
72: 
73:   // WHY: tipo 'all' distribui munição para todas as armas de munição (pickup W)
74:   addAmmo(type, qty) {
75:     if (type === 'all') {
76:       for (const k of ['pistol', 'shotgun', 'rocket']) {
77:         this.ammo[k] = min(C.WEAPON[k].maxAmmo, this.ammo[k] + qty);
78:       }
79:       return;
80:     }
81:     if (!C.WEAPON[type]) return;
82:     this.ammo[type] = min(C.WEAPON[type].maxAmmo, this.ammo[type] + qty);
83:   }
84: 
85:   fire(player, grid) {
86:     if (!this.canFire()) return null;
87:     const w = this.weapon;
88:     const key = this.key;
89:     this.cooldown = w.rate;
90:     if (key !== 'fist') this.ammo[key] -= w.ammoCost;
91: 
92:     switch (w.type) {
93:       case 'melee':
94:         return { type: 'melee', weapon: key, damage: w.damage, range: w.range };
95:       case 'hitscan':
96:         return { type: 'hitscan', weapon: key, damage: w.damage, hit: raycast(player, grid) };
97:       case 'spread': {
98:         const pellets = [];
99:         for (let i = 0; i < w.pellets; i++) pellets.push(raycast(player, grid, w.spread));
100:         return { type: 'spread', weapon: key, damage: w.damage, pellets };
101:       }
102:       case 'projectile':
103:         return {
104:           type: 'projectile',
105:           weapon: key,
106:           damage: w.damage,
107:           splash: w.splash,
108:           proj: {
109:             x: player.pos.x,
110:             z: player.pos.z,
111:             y: player.viewY ? 1.0 : 1.0,
112:             dx: Math.sin(player.yaw),
113:             dz: Math.cos(player.yaw),
114:             speed: 14,
115:             dist: 0,
116:           },
117:         };
118:       default:
119:         return null;
120:     }
121:   }
122: }
123: 
124: // WHY: inimigo mais próximo na linha de tiro (hitscan/spread) — W9: antes o tiro
125: // só colidia com o grid e nunca acertava inimigos (jogo injogável)
126: // WHY: frente = (sin yaw, -cos yaw) — convenção R_y(-yaw) dos testes de movimento
127: const raycastEnemy = (player, grid, enemies, maxDist, doors = []) => {
128:   const dirX = Math.sin(player.yaw);
129:   const dirZ = -Math.cos(player.yaw);
130:   let best = null;
131:   let bestAlong = Infinity;
132:   for (const e of enemies) {
133:     if (e.dead) continue;
134:     const dx = e.pos.x - player.pos.x;
135:     const dz = e.pos.z - player.pos.z;
136:     const along = dx * dirX + dz * dirZ;
137:     if (along <= 0 || along > maxDist) continue;
138:     // WHY: distância perpendicular ao raio — acerta se o centro está a < size*0.5 do raio
139:     const perp = Math.abs(dx * dirZ - dz * dirX);
140:     if (perp > e.stats.size * 0.5) continue;
141:     if (!hasLineOfSight(grid, player.pos.x, player.pos.z, e.pos.x, e.pos.z, doors)) continue;
142:     if (along < bestAlong) { best = e; bestAlong = along; }
143:   }
144:   return best;
145: };
146: 
147: // WHY: inimigo mais próximo dentro do alcance melee (dano por proximidade — DOOM)
148: const meleeTarget = (player, enemies, range) => {
149:   let best = null;
150:   let bestDist = range;
151:   for (const e of enemies) {
152:     if (e.dead) continue;
153:     const d = hypot(e.pos.x - player.pos.x, e.pos.z - player.pos.z);
154:     if (d <= bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = e; }
155:   }
156:   return best;
157: };
158: 
159: export { WeaponSystem, raycast, raycastEnemy, meleeTarget };

1: // js/game.js — W6: game loop fixed-step 60Hz + máquina de estados
2: // rAF injetável (browser real ou stub de teste); step() síncrono testável
3: 
4: const FIXED_DT = 1 / 60;
5: const MAX_FRAME = 0.25; // clamp contra tab switch (dt em segundos)
6: 
7: const STATES = { MENU: 'MENU', PLAYING: 'PLAYING', PAUSED: 'PAUSED', GAMEOVER: 'GAMEOVER', WIN: 'WIN' };
8: 
9: class Game {
10:   constructor({ update, render, requestFrame = null }) {
11:     this.update = update;
12:     this.render = render;
13:     // WHY: requestFrame injetável — browser usa rAF; testes usam stub/step direto
14:     this.requestFrame = requestFrame ?? ((cb) => {
15:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.requestAnimationFrame) window.requestAnimationFrame(cb);
16:     });
17:     this.state = STATES.MENU;
18:     this.time = 0;
19:     this.acc = 0;
20:     this.last = 0;
21:     this.frame = 0;
22:     this.running = false;
23:   }
24: 
25:   start() {
26:     if (this.running) return;
27:     this.running = true;
28:     this.last = performance.now();
29:     this.frame = 0;
30:     const loop = (now) => {
31:       if (!this.running) return;
32:       this.step(now);
33:       this.requestFrame(loop);
34:     };
35:     this.requestFrame(loop);
36:   }
37: 
38:   stop() { this.running = false; }
39: 
40:   // WHY: passo síncrono — acumula dt real e processa N passos fixos de 1/60
41:   step(now) {
42:     if (!this.running) return;
43:     const dt = Math.min(Math.max((now - this.last) / 1000, 0), MAX_FRAME);
44:     this.last = now;
45:     this.acc += dt;
46:     while (this.acc >= FIXED_DT) {
47:       // WHY: self-healing anti-freeze — exceção em update NUNCA mata o rAF
48:       // (bug W9: TypeError em moveAxis fora do grid congelava o jogo inteiro;
49:       // agora loga, descarta o passo e o loop continua vivo)
50:       try {
51:         this.update(FIXED_DT);
52:       } catch (err) {
53:         console.error('[game.step] update error:', err);
54:       }
55:       this.time += FIXED_DT;
56:       this.acc -= FIXED_DT;
57:       this.frame += 1;
58:     }
59:     try {
60:       this.render();
61:     } catch (err) {
62:       console.error('[game.step] render error:', err);
63:     }
64:   }
65: 
66:   // WHY: transições de estado (Menu→Play→Pause→GameOver/Win)
67:   startGame() { this.state = STATES.PLAYING; }
68:   pause() { if (this.state === STATES.PLAYING) this.state = STATES.PAUSED; }
69:   resume() { if (this.state === STATES.PAUSED) this.state = STATES.PLAYING; }
70:   togglePause() { if (this.state === STATES.PLAYING) this.pause(); else if (this.state === STATES.PAUSED) this.resume(); }
71:   gameOver() { this.state = STATES.GAMEOVER; }
72:   win() { this.state = STATES.WIN; }
73: }
74: 
75: export { Game, STATES, FIXED_DT };

12: const coveredLines = (f) => new Set(
13:   Object.entries(f.s).filter(([, c]) => c > 0).map(([id]) => f.statementMap[id].start.line),
14: ).size;
15: const totalLines = (f) => new Set(Object.values(f.statementMap).map((s) => s.start.line)).size;
16: const covered = (f, map) => Object.values(f[map]).filter((c) => c > 0).length;
17: const total = (f, map) => Object.keys(f[map]).length;
18: 
19: test('cobertura total > 80% (c8)', {
20:   skip: !existsSync(COV) && 'sem relatório — rode: npx c8 --reporter=lcov --reporter=json node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"',

100:   };

2: // rAF injetável (browser real ou stub de teste); step() síncrono testável
3: 
4: const FIXED_DT = 1 / 60;
5: const MAX_FRAME = 0.25; // clamp contra tab switch (dt em segundos)
6: 
7: const STATES = { MENU: 'MENU', PLAYING: 'PLAYING', PAUSED: 'PAUSED', GAMEOVER: 'GAMEOVER', WIN: 'WIN' };
8: 
9: class Game {
10:   constructor({ update, render, requestFrame = null }) {
11:     this.update = update;
12:     this.render = render;
13:     // WHY: requestFrame injetável — browser usa rAF; testes usam stub/step direto
14:     this.requestFrame = requestFrame ?? ((cb) => {
15:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.requestAnimationFrame) window.requestAnimationFrame(cb);
16:     });
17:     this.state = STATES.MENU;
18:     this.time = 0;
19:     this.acc = 0;
20:     this.last = 0;
21:     this.frame = 0;
22:     this.running = false;
23:   }
24: 
25:   start() {
26:     if (this.running) return;
27:     this.running = true;
28:     this.last = performance.now();
29:     this.frame = 0;
30:     const loop = (now) => {
31:       if (!this.running) return;
32:       this.step(now);
33:       this.requestFrame(loop);
34:     };
35:     this.requestFrame(loop);
36:   }
37: 
38:   stop() { this.running = false; }
39: 
40:   // WHY: passo síncrono — acumula dt real e processa N passos fixos de 1/60
41:   step(now) {
42:     if (!this.running) return;
43:     const dt = Math.min(Math.max((now - this.last) / 1000, 0), MAX_FRAME);
44:     this.last = now;
45:     this.acc += dt;
46:     while (this.acc >= FIXED_DT) {
47:       // WHY: self-healing anti-freeze — exceção em update NUNCA mata o rAF
48:       // (bug W9: TypeError em moveAxis fora do grid congelava o jogo inteiro;
49:       // agora loga, descarta o passo e o loop continua vivo)
50:       try {
51:         this.update(FIXED_DT);
52:       } catch (err) {
53:         console.error('[game.step] update error:', err);
54:       }
55:       this.time += FIXED_DT;
56:       this.acc -= FIXED_DT;
57:       this.frame += 1;
58:     }
59:     try {
60:       this.render();
61:     } catch (err) {
62:       console.error('[game.step] render error:', err);
63:     }
64:   }
65: 
66:   // WHY: transições de estado (Menu→Play→Pause→GameOver/Win)
67:   startGame() { this.state = STATES.PLAYING; }
68:   pause() { if (this.state === STATES.PLAYING) this.state = STATES.PAUSED; }
69:   resume() { if (this.state === STATES.PAUSED) this.state = STATES.PLAYING; }
70:   togglePause() { if (this.state === STATES.PLAYING) this.pause(); else if (this.state === STATES.PAUSED) this.resume(); }
71:   gameOver() { this.state = STATES.GAMEOVER; }
72:   win() { this.state = STATES.WIN; }
73: }
